summary: Australia, software developer, extensive experience with Linux and UNIX, strong advocate for single-payer healthcare, interest in programming languages (especially COBOL), history enthusiast, enjoys reading and collecting books, has undergone significant health issues (triple bypass surgery), married with children, prefers minimalist desktop environments (Mint MATE), uses a Lenovo ThinkPad T410S, critical of Microsoft practices, skeptical of social media, prefers CLI over GUI for tasks, believes in the importance of backups and data management, views population growth as a major global issue.
